listing.aiSummary: Adds a collection of ships, weapons, and hullmods.

description:
The mod is for v0.98

I made some ships and weapons. Go play with them.

v1.6.6
-Update for current game version, some balans
-No more giant triangles from shieldgens
-More dakkadispenser blacklisting
-Multiple flux batteries have separate HUD entries

Requires LazyLib, GraphicsLib, MagicLib.

FuzzyPack is a content pack with ships, weapons and hullmods.

DL: https://github.com/SirFuzzWuzz/Starsector_mods/raw/main/FuzzyPack.zip

Sample of other features:
-Dakka Dispenser, shotgun that can fire ANY projectile in the game
-Heavy Flamer
-ERA hullmod to make enemies pay for breaking your armour.
-Martyr Pilots, turn any fighter into a human guided missile.
-The Moth phase 'carrier', heavily armoured phase ship using gremlin level phase tech.
-The Redentor capital ship, large low tech capital ship with great firepower.
-The Boring drone, heavy duty mining drone that can cut through any asteroid.
-Shatterer Artillery, fire shells arcing into the z-axis, also has a neat crosshair.
-Redstone Torpedo, activate the systems of hit ships or fry their ships
-Shield Projector, weapon slot mounted shield generator

I'm very inactive on the forum but the download link should always be up to date.
For feedback etc discord is the best, I'm in both USC and Corvus.

Credit to turklr, fellout for kitbashing material, arthr for hullmod icons.

The image is outdated so you'll just have to download to find out what's new :)

Spoiler
